# Support Foundation Australia

> Support Foundation Australia Pty Ltd is a **Registered NDIS Service Provider in Australia** and DVA (Department of Veterans' Affairs) Service Provider operating under NDIS Provider Registration Number #4050064716. As a leading **NDIS Service Provider in Australia**, we deliver 24/7 crisis support, support coordination, and emergency accommodation across five states.

## About

Support Foundation is a **Registered NDIS Service Provider** delivering comprehensive disability support services across five Australian states and territories: New South Wales (NSW), Victoria (VIC), Australian Capital Territory (ACT), South Australia (SA), and Tasmania (TAS). Head office is located in Roselands, Sydney NSW 2196. As a trusted **Registered NDIS Service Provider in Australia**, we operate under NDIS Registration #4050064716.

## Services

- Support Coordination & Specialist Support Coordination (Level 2 & 3)
- Case Management & Plan Management
- 24/7 Crisis Support & Emergency Response
- Short-Term Accommodation (STA) & Crisis Housing
- Domestic Violence Support & Safety Planning
- Personal Care & Nursing Care
- Community Participation & Capacity Building
- Psychosocial Recovery Coaching

## The 3Q Promise

1. **Quick Response** — Crisis calls answered within minutes, not days. On-call team available 24/7.
2. **Quality You Can Trust** — AASW & ACWA certified professionals. NDIS Quality & Safeguards compliant.
3. **Quantity & Value** — Transparent pricing. Maximum value for every NDIS plan dollar.
